newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Estee Lauder rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Estee Lauder rated a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros analyst Carol Warner said in a research note she intiated coverage of Estee Lauder Cos Inc with a buy recommendation and 12-month price target of $60 per share.
-- Shares were up 5/8 to 50 in late morning NYSE trade.

-- "With a strong financial position and opportunities to expand internationally and through product development, we anticipate growth unmatched by many of its peers, justifying a price-earnings ratio of twice the company's growth rate," according to the research note.
-- The shares are currently trading at a P/E multiple of 33.1 times the Salomon 1997 earnings estimate of $1.40 per share. The 1998 estimate is $1.65 per share.
